quote: An awaited tool hook can outlive a user’s role downgrade while retaining the old `operator.admin` scope in a synthetic client; Gateway method routing trusts that stale scope before a privileged side effect.
note: The P1 item “Revalidate role scopes before in-process tool dispatch” points to how the dispatcher carries administrator authority into synthetic clients. Its proposed fix addresses stale scopes after a role downgrade and would leave the dispatcher free to add admin back after a native request explicitly narrowed its scopes.
